title: No unhandledRejection handler and many un-awaited async calls: one escaped rejection exits the process and takes every exit monitor and anti-rug subscription down with it

evidence.note: V3 WS listener calls handleNewV3PoolForChain without await or .catch
V2 WS listener calls handleNewPairForChain without await or .catch
startHttpPollingListener is called without await; its first awaited getBlockNumber (:1632 / :1656) rejects on an RPC error
startMultiChainBot() is called without await or .catch
async MEV health setInterval with no try/catch
async wallet-balance setInterval with no try/catch (checkWalletBalance, getPauseState, setPauseState, forceWalCheckpoint can throw)
async handleWsCloseV3 registered as a raw socket close listener; a rejection is not handled
example throw point outside any try in the V2 handler
the catch body itself can throw (updateTradeStatus.run inside catch), escaping the handler

evidence.ref: git grep -n -e unhandledRejection -e uncaughtException 23a64617dca167976adc4645fed0e2c69e384820 -- src scripts
evidence.note: no matches: there is no process-level handler anywhere in src/ or scripts/
exit=1 under v22.16.0: an unhandled rejection terminates the process even with a live interval timer (Node default --unhandled-rejections=throw)

concrete trigger found during the threshold inventory: parseEther(<envPrefix>_MIN_LIQUIDITY) runs before the try in checkMinLiquidity (:190) and before the V3 honeypot gate; a non-numeric value (not validated at load, chainRegistry.ts:665) rejects the un-awaited V3 handler on the first pool and exits the process (TH-BUY-08)
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Listener callbacks discard rejecting handler promises

sibling_sites_checked: Every async call site in bot.ts was read: listener callbacks (:1542, :1583), poll dispatches (:1644, :1669), the un-awaited poll starter (:1531), the entry point (:2360), the four setInterval callbacks (:1636, :1660, :1740, :1774; the two poll loops have try/catch around their bodies, the two health/balance loops do not), the two close handlers, resumeMultiChainMonitoring (.then/.catch present, :1934-1959, contained) and the shutdown disconnect (.catch present, :2323). telegramListener.ts:121 contains with .catch (correct). The exit engine poll loop has its own try/catch (exitEngine.ts:1906-1942, EXIT slice).
severity_rationale: S1, equal to the research suggestion. Node 22.16.0 exits with code 1 on an unhandled rejection even while timers are live (command evidence below). Exit monitors and anti-rug are in-process timers and subscriptions, so every open position is unprotected from the crash until someone restarts the bot. Plausible condition: any throw on one of the un-awaited paths listed.
recommendation: Decide the policy on card OD-6 (per-handler containment, a global handler, or both, and whether a global handler shuts down or continues). Phase 24; nothing is changed in Phase 22.
